note: Market typology on the 606-district analysis set, on POPULATION shares: each facility is the share of the district's rural population living in a village that reports it. 'density' is the mean percentile rank of the nine facilities other than the weekly haat; types cross density terciles with weekly haat share above or below the median. Keys match districts.geojson 'k'.

types.name: Few facilities
types.rule: bottom third on shops, markets and FPOs, and few haats

types.name: Weekly haats, little else
types.rule: bottom third on shops, markets and FPOs, more haats than the median

types.name: Some shops and FPOs, few haats
types.rule: middle third on shops, markets and FPOs, few haats

types.name: Some shops and FPOs, with haats
types.rule: middle third on shops, markets and FPOs, more haats than the median

types.name: Shops, FPOs and markets, few haats
types.rule: top third on shops, markets and FPOs, few haats

types.name: Shops, FPOs and markets, with haats
types.rule: top third on shops, markets and FPOs, more haats than the median
